P15-19.name: Spirit Santa
P15-19.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) on this Spirit to your Trash, each player reveals a card from their decktop. If that card is a Spirit card, the opponent, and then you, can summon it without paying the cost. If not summoning, or if it's another card, return it to the deckbottom.

P14-41.name: The AstralKingBlade Alphecca
P14-41.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit. If your Life is at three or less, instead, destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit/Brave Ultimate.

[When Braved] (When this Spirit/Ultimate Brave Attacks)
For each of your Brave Spirits/Brave Ultimates, this Spirit/Ultimate gains +2000 BP.

P15-17.name: The Minis' Great Athletics Meeting
P15-17.effect:
You can put any number of [The Minis' Great Athletics Meeting] in your deck.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
For each [The Minis' Great Athletics Meeting] you control, all your Spirits gain +1000 BP.
